title: GhostPay
tagline: GhostPay provides a no-code platform accessible to anyone that enables the creation of custom paymasters, enabling a smoother UX for users on the EVM.

prizes.placement: Grand Prize for Overall Best Web3Auth Integration
prizes.title: Grand Prize for Overall Best Web3Auth Integration

description: The benefits of GhostPay include increasing the flexibility of gas policies, simplifying the web3 onboarding experience for new users, and adding greater programmability to transactions by reducing the friction of funding a wallet with native currency to complete on-chain transactions. Dapps can attract new users, improve the user experience and incentive user behaviour by sponsoring network fees for users on behalf of the newly created paymaster.
how_its_made: GhostPay login process is designed to be intuitive and straightforward. By leveraging Web3Auth, users can simply scan the QR code and the NFC wristband provided to create a Safe smart account, enabling seamless access to the platform. Once logged in, users can create custom paymasters just with a few clicks. GhostPay makes use of Chronicle Oracle in order to fetch verifiable data such as ERC-20 token prices. We also make use of Subgraphs to index  paymaster info like the owner, he amount and the set up fee  revenue. Base Network is where all smart contracts are deployed. For the use case we have chosen a simple transfer but using ApeCoin as the token for paying the gas fees.
